stage1.impression: A deep, warm room in a believable perspective with good bones: fir beams, a curved timber counter, a banquette, a record wall. It still reads as CG. The floor is a grey slab with smeared dark blotches, the counter top is a near-white glare, the two dark door-jamb masses at the frame edges crush to nothing, and the hanging globe reads as thin neon hoops (a toy or a gyroscope) rather than thick cast acrylic, so the only colour in the frame looks like signage. As it stands a magazine would see a generic, well-proportioned bar render, not a specific place. The specific things (the speakers as an altar, the record player, the Orbs' tint) are invisible or white.

blocking_9: Mother EARF must read as six thick slotted cast-acrylic discs with tinted bodies and glowing polished rims, not as wireframe neon hoops; its region [340,225,480,365] lum_median >= 45 with visible tint in the disc faces

The Tropos speakers (the altar pair and the niche pair) must be legible at a glance as smoked acrylic horns. Now the edge masses at [1005,110,1200,800] are 52.6% crushed and [0,120,130,800] has a median of 6
The floor must read as real polished concrete at 1:1: no smeared dark blotches, a clean stone texture with soft pools under each lamp
The counter top must hold detail and warmth (lum_p95 < 235, warm, not white-grey glare)
The Orb table lamps in the foreground must show the smoked tint around the frosted liner, not pure white balls
Some sign of the street beyond the shopfront glass, and a reason for this to be EARF's room and not any bar

defects.what: Floor: irregular dark smeared blotches like wet stains or denoiser smear; reads as a dirty CG texture, not concrete
Mother EARF reads as thin neon wire hoops with nearly transparent dark disc faces; no thickness, no tint in the discs, looks like a toy or a gyroscope; no visible suspension
Counter top near white and close to clipping (p95 251, clip 0.44%), cold grey; flat, no material
Right foreground mass crushed (crush_pct 52.6, median 2.6) over 14% of the frame; the speaker or jamb there is unreadable
Left foreground mass nearly black (median 6.3); the altar speaker, if that is it, is invisible
Foreground Orb is a pure white frosted ball with no smoked shell visible
Second foreground Orb also pure white, tangent to the frame's bottom edge
Record-wall niches read as raw pink-orange MDF boxes; the niche speakers inside are dark and unreadable
Shopfront and street: grey and empty; the window is a flat grey panel with no street life; the back-wall pendants bloom against a flat pale panel
Ceiling band above the beams is a flat dark-brown slab with streaky texture, 15% of the frame doing nothing
Screens show pale lavender ghost hands; the cool cast and the brightness (median 93) compete with the globe
Row of identical bar stools with brass rings, visibly the same model repeated

changes.problem: The centrepiece reads as thin neon hoops: the rims glow but the 25 mm disc bodies carry no tint or light, so it looks like a wire toy, and it is darker than the floor under it.

evidence.measured: lum_median 37.9, p5 15.8; disc faces see-through and dark at 3x crop; floor below [130,450,700,800] median 62.7

change.setting: Mother EARF rim glow, and its hard spot
change.from: rim glow 0.025, hard spot 135.0 W cone 20 deg
change.to: rim glow 0.012 (rims less neon), hard spot 260 W cone 26 deg so it fills all six discs and the light passes through their tinted bodies, plus haze 0.003 -> 0.006 so the coloured beam reads in the air

changes.expected: The discs read as tinted glass slabs with glowing edges; the globe becomes the brightest coloured object, and the coloured shadow on the wall stays strong

changes.problem: The floor has smeared dark blotches that read as a dirty CG texture or denoiser smear, and it is the brightest large surface in the frame.

evidence.measured: lum_median 102.7, p5 27.8; irregular blob-shaped dark patches at 2x crop

change.setting: floor's polish and the concrete's tone
change.from: the current floor, mottled with large dark stains, matte-light
change.to: a darker, warmer, honed concrete (albedo about 0.18), roughness 0.35 with a subtle polish so the pendants and Orbs reflect as soft streaks; remove the large-scale stain layer and keep only fine aggregate and faint trowel marks

changes.expected: The floor falls off into darkness between pools, with no blotches, and stops competing with the globe and the counter

changes.problem: The counter top is a near-clipped cold white slab with no material.

change.from: 4 x spot 32.0 W, 2400 K, cone 20 deg
change.to: 4 x spot 16 W, 2200 K, cone 24 deg; and the counter top finish darker, with more sheen (zinc patina deepened)

changes.expected: Warm pools on the counter with visible glasses and their highlights, the top holding texture

changes.problem: The speakers in the foreground (the altar pair at the frame edges) are crushed black, so the product the room sells is invisible.

change.setting: the altar's spots and the lamps on the speakers
change.from: altar 2 x spot 170 W 2500 K cone 30 deg; speaker areas 1.0 W/m2
change.to: altar spots re-aimed to graze the speakers' faces and horns from above, 220 W, cone 24 deg; speaker areas 3.0 W/m2 at 2700 K so the smoked acrylic edges and white batts read

changes.expected: Both edge speakers show their silhouette, smoked tint and polished edges against a dark ground

changes.problem: The camera sits behind two near-black masses that eat 25% of the frame and push the hero speakers out of view; the ceiling band adds another 15% of dead dark.

evidence.measured: ceiling band median 13.5; edge masses median 2.6 and 6.3

change.to: position [14.2, 3.0, 1.30] (seated eye height, forward of the jambs), 32 mm, target [2.0, 2.9, 1.25], so one altar speaker sits in the left third with its face lit and Mother EARF stays high centre-left

changes.expected: The frame opens onto the room, with one Tropos speaker as a readable foreground hero and less dead ceiling

changes.problem: The Orb table lamps read as pure white frosted balls, which says cheap plastic globe rather than a smoked acrylic lamp.

evidence.measured: near-white ball, p95 225 in [70,690,400,800], no visible tint shell at 2x crop

change.setting: each Orb's glow and how rough the frosted acrylic is
change.to: Orb 0.12 W, glow 0.0035, and the frosted liner's roughness lowered so the smoked outer shell and its polished rim read around a softer warm core

changes.expected: The Orbs show a smoky shell with a warm glowing heart, and the foreground highlights stop at about 220

changes.problem: The screens are pale lavender, cool and bright, and they compete with the globe as a second colour.

evidence.measured: lum_median 93.4, r/g/b 112/89/87 against a warm room

changes.expected: The screens sit back as dim, near-neutral panels and the globe and its shadow lead the left wall

changes.problem: The shopfront and street read as a flat grey panel, so there is no street beyond and no sense of place at night.

evidence.measured: lum_median 36.4, flat grey with no point sources or reflections

change.setting: street lamps, and the window's etched name
change.from: 2 x point 8.0 W 2700 K; etched name 0.01
change.to: 2 x point 40 W 2700 K placed outside so the street gives sodium-warm pools and reflections in the glass; etched name 0.03

changes.expected: A dim but legible street beyond the glass with a couple of highlights, giving the depth of the room an end

out_of_scope.request: Make Mother EARF's discs visibly thicker, or reduce its six saturated tints so the room has one colour
out_of_scope.why: The globe's shape, its discs and the colours the owner chose are fixed; only its light can change

out_of_scope.request: Vary the bar stools (a different model or a mix)
out_of_scope.why: The seats are fixed in the room's design; the repetition can only be broken by props (a coat, a bag) and the camera

out_of_scope.request: Replace the record-wall niches' pink-orange box look with a darker finish or a different joinery
out_of_scope.why: The back bar and record wall are fixed; only the oak's stain and the spots may change. A darker stain is worth trying

out_of_scope.request: Fill the dead ceiling band with structure
out_of_scope.why: The ceiling is part of the fixed room; handled by the camera change c5 instead
